posts.title: Ramblings 717
posts.description: My death feels like a need My mind wholly agrees My resistance desintegrates Then my heart complies

posts.title: FRIENDS FOR DINNER
posts.description: Give me the pleasure of friends Who share a meal with love Who relish in the exchange of words, Of thoughts, and of appreciation. We shall sit in soft seats Around a smooth teak-wood table Overlooking a peaceful azure sea Speaking of our aligned passions Generating a host of imaginings To fill the day till night And then under a starlit sky Drink a mellow toast or two To ease our joyful bodies Towards fullfilling dreams. © Griffonner 2026
